Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
I purchased my 22" kettle grill when I was 19. That was over 20 years ago and it is still going strong. We purchased the Spirit II because of the Weber quality and we wanted the ease of a gas grill for those hectic nights when you want to get something grilled, quick. It does more than grill quick!!! I have since slow cooked a couple pork loins, several whole chickens, pizza (frozen and fresh), asparagus and a multitude of fruits. This grill is awesome!! Such juicy and flavorful food! I still love my kettle cooker and it is not retired but the Spirit II is fast becoming our go to grill.
You could purchase a cheaper grill but I will guarantee that those cheaper grills will not last near as long as a Weber. Go ahead and read the reviews of the $200 grills, most people are unhappy because of rusting out bottoms after a year and the unavailability of parts along with a not so great grilling experience. Take the plunge now and you will have a grill that will last you many years. I have been happy with Weber products for over 20 years and they will continue to have a loyal customer for many more!

Results.ReviewText: This is my third Weber grill and I've loved each one. The Spirit E-310 has all of the features you need and the right size cooking surface to feed a party. The E-310 reminds me of my first Weber--high quality, basic features, built to last.  The E-310 has a well balanced 3 burner cooking surface.  The heat is evenly distributed, unlike many other grills I've used. I see the E-310 as a best buy for quality, features and price. I would give 5 stars if it had a handle for moving the grill. I've improvised my own, but a built in would be a great feature.

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I used to have a very cheap gas grill. The burners kept burning through so I decided to go with charcoal. I started using a charcoal grill in 2006. I decided it was time for a change. I think I made a wise choice to go with the Weber E-310. The first time I fired up the gas grill, I let it warm up for 10 minutes. It only got up to about 300°. It was then that I read the instructions. Instead of turning the burners on high, I had all three on low. I tried burgers first, turned out nice and juicy. Then I cooked a rack of ribs. They were good but not as good as charcoal and wood chips (I'll try again...and again). My next attempt was a beer can chicken. That turned out pretty good. Again, practice makes perfect. I think I'm off to a good start. I'll edit my review when I've had more practice.

Results.ReviewText: Bought this as a replacement for a 4 burner grill. This Weber is so much more useful, and I don’t regret the smaller size. Best grill I’ve had at maintaining the right temp. Easy to clean the entire inside as everything removes quickly and gives 100% access. The reversible grates are a nice touch, but I have only used the larger side. Very well made and stylish in red.

Results.Title: Fantastic Grill

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: This is the first time i ever sprung for a Weber, and i have been kicking myself for not doing this sooner.  It makes the best grilled food, and is the easiest grill i have ever had to clean.   The customer service was also second to none, i got it out of the box and it had a small dent in the hood, and i called and sent pictures and i had a whole new hood within a few days at no cost.  I would highly recommend Weber to anyone, and will never own a grill by another name.  I also now plan to buy the Q-1200 for our camper.

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: This grill is great.  It is a good size and the two shelves are very helpful.  The burners works just the way you would want it to.  Quickly heats to 500+ degrees and has great heat control.  The only complaint that I have is with delivery.  Self installation was simple enough with the instructions, but we received multiple bent pieces straight out of the box.  I included a few pictures after I attempted to bend pieces back to a useable shape.  Made installation a bit tricky.
Results.Title: This grill is terrific

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)

Photos.Caption: Old Faithful on the Left - Big Red on the Right...

Results.ReviewText: This new grill was a Father’s Day present and birthday combo.  I never wanted to get rid of my 19 year old Genesis Silver A that we bought in 2000.  The old grill was so well supported by Weber that my wife decided to stay with Weber for the gift.  We practically gave old faithful away with the bottle to make sure that it found a home.   As for the new grill - this thing is awesome!!!!  Larger cook surface and bold red work for me.  The cooking is very even and I like the new ignition system.
Results.Title: It was a difficult but pleasant change

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
Great build quality grill. The lid and handle are very sturdy. The propane tank is supported on the side of the grill very well. Moving the grill has a solid feel.
Cooking with the cast iron grates provide an even heat. No need to avoid high and low temp areas like other cheap grills. Weber's are pricey but worth the extra $$.
Results.Title: Excellent build quality, even heating

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: It's a great gas grill. Heats up fast and cools down quick after. Easily cleaned. Light easily first time. Perfect for my family of four.

45010001.Name: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
45010001.Description:
Get ready to step up your grilling experience. As the family sits down for dinner, or a couple of friends come over for a bite – this three burner grill will do its magic. With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.


 This product requires assembly.
